description: Source code for the VoiceControl plugin, implementing JSON-RPC methods, event handling, and IARM bus interactions for voice session management.

classes.name: VoiceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class managing voice sessions, events, and IARM bus communication.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM connections, and mask PII setting.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and disconnects from IARM bus.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Registers event handlers on the IARM bus.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes event handlers from the IARM bus.

methods.name: voiceEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for IARM events, delegates to instance handler.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles specific IARM events related to voice sessions.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number.

methods.name: getMaskPii_
methods.description: Retrieves the mask PII setting from current voice status.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Queries the current voice status via IARM call.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures voice settings via IARM call.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Initializes voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a voice message via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Deprecated method translating parameters and calling voiceSessionRequest.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported voice session types via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Starts a voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates a voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts audio streaming for a voice session via IARM call.

methods.name: onSessionBegin
methods.description: Handles session begin event, sends notification.

methods.name: onStreamBegin
methods.description: Handles stream begin event, sends notification.

methods.name: onKeywordVerification
methods.description: Handles keyword verification event, sends notification.

methods.name: onServerMessage
methods.description: Handles server message event, sends notification.

methods.name: onStreamEnd
methods.description: Handles stream end event, sends notification.

methods.name: onSessionEnd
methods.description: Handles session end event, sends notification.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the API version number.

methods.name: sendNotify_
methods.description: Sends event notification, masking PII if configured.
